Check that each district has one admin level 1 name in the Admin sheet

Source: R/0_data_quality_checks.R
check_admin_pairing_consistency.Rd

Checks that no district is listed in the Admin sheet under more than one admin level 1 unit. This is the part of check_district_consistency() that can run before the sheets are merged.

Usage

check_admin_pairing_consistency(admin_data)

Arguments

admin_data

A data frame. The cleaned Admin sheet, before the sheets are merged, with district and first_admin_level columns.

Value

NULL if every district has one admin level 1 name, or if the sheet lacks either column. Otherwise a character vector of length one, named "x", with a message that lists the districts.

Details

Admin level 1 names are compared without regard to case or extra spaces.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core")
sheets <- load_excel_parts(path)
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
admin <- sheets$parts[[sheets$admin_sheet_name]]
check_admin_pairing_consistency(admin)
#> NULL

# The first district listed a second time, under another region
again <- admin[1, ]
again$first_admin_level <- "Western"
check_admin_pairing_consistency(rbind(admin, again))
#>                                                                            x 
#> "District(s) with an inconsistent admin-1 name in the Admin sheet: Baringo."
